epic.title: Migrate CodeSearch from SQLite to pgvector-only
epic.description: Eliminate SQLite dependency and move all CodeSearch storage to PostgreSQL with pgvector for unified vector search infrastructure
epic.business_value: Consolidates vector search infrastructure, eliminates 12GB+ SQLite files, enables cross-project searches via shared postgres

sqlite_usage: entities table - code symbols (functions, classes, etc)

benefits: HNSW index for O(log n) similarity search vs O(n) SQLite scan
Cross-project queries without loading multiple DBs

sprints.title: PostgreSQL Schema & Store Layer
sprints.goal: Create PostgreSQL schema and Rust store implementation

tasks.title: Create PostgreSQL schema for entities and refs
tasks.description: Add codesearch.entities and codesearch.refs tables to match SQLite schema
acceptance: entities table with: id, kind, name, signature, visibility, parent_id, file_path, line_number, doc_comment, project_root, created_at
refs table with: id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, ref_kind, file_path, line_number
Indexes on project_root, file_path, name for fast lookups

tasks.title: Implement PgStore in Rust
tasks.description: Create store_pg.rs with full CRUD operations matching StoreV2 interface

tasks.title: Add async runtime to CLI
tasks.description: Wrap main() in tokio runtime for async postgres operations
acceptance: All commands can call async store methods

sprints.title: Migrate CLI Commands
sprints.goal: Update all CLI commands to use PostgreSQL store

tasks.title: Migrate init command
tasks.description: Remove SQLite init, verify postgres schema exists
acceptance: Connects to postgres and verifies codesearch schema

tasks.title: Migrate index command
tasks.description: Write entities and embeddings to postgres

tasks.title: Migrate find/refs commands
acceptance: All structured queries work against postgres
Performance comparable to SQLite for small result sets

tasks.title: Remove SQLite dependencies
tasks.description: Delete rusqlite from Cargo.toml and all SQLite modules

tasks.title: Update paths module
tasks.description: Remove SQLite path functions, add postgres URL config
acceptance: get_pg_url() returns connection string from env or default

tasks.title: Integration tests
acceptance: init -> index -> query -> stats workflow passes

tasks.title: Performance benchmark
tasks.description: Compare pgvector vs old SQLite performance
acceptance: Index time comparable or better than SQLite

risks.risk: Postgres not running blocks all codesearch operations
risks.mitigation: Add health check to CLI, clear error message with docker start command

risks.risk: Network latency vs local SQLite file
risks.mitigation: Connection pooling, batch operations, HNSW index offsets query overhead

risks.risk: Breaking change for existing index data
risks.mitigation: One-time migration script, document in CHANGELOG

out_of_scope: Multi-tenant isolation (all projects share same postgres)
Cloud-hosted postgres (local docker only for now)
success_criteria: codesearch binary has no rusqlite dependency
All CLI commands work with postgres backend
Semantic search is faster than SQLite for >10k embeddings
